existing_rows_audit.detail: The Amsterdam office is confirmed (HQ, ~400 staff, https://www.flowtraders.com/about-us/where-we-operate/) and C++ roles are genuinely open there, but the posted title is "Senior Software Engineer, C++" — two live reqs, https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/flowtraders/jobs/8025933 (5+ yrs) and https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/flowtraders/jobs/7992594 (7+ yrs). No req titled "C++ Developer" exists on the board.

The existing row's gate reading is wrong in the candidate's favour and should be corrected. It says "New-grad OR entry-level req — recent grads accepted; you qualify". Both live Amsterdam C++ reqs demand 5+ and 7+ years of POST-GRADUATION professional C++ experience respectively (verbatim from https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/flowtraders/jobs/8025933 and .../7992594). There is no entry-level C++ engineering opening in Amsterdam; the only entry-level Amsterdam route is the Graduate Trader programme, which is a different track.

No compensation figure appears anywhere in the Flow Traders postings or on flowtraders.com; the reqs say only "competitive salary, annual discretionary profit share". The €75–115k range is unsourced and should be treated as an estimate, not verified data. Note also that Flow Traders is Euronext-listed (FLOW) and publishes aggregate employee expenses, but nothing per-role.

notes:
Method: the flowtraders.com job-search page is a Vue app that renders nothing to a plain fetch, so I read /js/job-search.js, found it calls the Greenhouse Boards API for board `flowtraders`, and pulled the full board (37 reqs, content=true) plus the offices endpoint. Every posting listed above was read in full from that primary feed, and I spot-checked that the same req IDs resolve to HTTP 200 on flowtraders.com/careers/job-description/<id>, so these are the firm's own live listings.

Offices: confirmed from https://www.flowtraders.com/about-us/where-we-operate/ — Amsterdam (HQ), Cluj-Napoca, London, Milan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Shanghai are all in scope; Chicago and New York are out of scope. There is NO Tokyo office. The "Japan" location tag on req 8025635 is a targeting label for a Japan-coverage seat that is physically in Hong Kong — do not read it as a Tokyo presence.

Coverage gaps: Singapore and Cluj-Napoca appear in the Greenhouse office list but have ZERO live openings today; Milan and Shanghai are real offices that do not appear in the Greenhouse office taxonomy at all and have no listings. So the in-scope live hiring is entirely Amsterdam, London and Hong Kong.

Deliberately excluded as out of track: Hong Kong Network Engineer (6743078, Cisco/Arista network infrastructure) and Hong Kong Trading Operations Engineer (7965410, Python/Kubernetes/Terraform DevOps) — both are infrastructure/ops rather than C++ or ML, though the latter is latency-adjacent if the candidate wants to widen the net. Also excluded: all Amsterdam/Hong Kong business-support reqs (Compliance Officer - Regulatory, Operations Specialist, Lead HR Generalist, Senior Market Risk Manager, Institutional Sales - Nordic, Campus Recruiter, Technical Support Engineer) and the W3BWAVE digital-assets talent pool, which is a pipeline sign-up rather than a role.

Hiring process: applications are accepted year-round; Flow explicitly recommends attending an "e-house day" before applying to the graduate track (https://www.flowtraders.com/careers/). No compensation figure is stated on any posting, so comp_local is empty for every role — do not backfill it.

Overall read for this candidate: Flow Traders' in-scope engineering openings are all senior (5-10 years), which sits awkwardly against ~18 months of experience by a mid-2027 start. The three genuinely worth pursuing are the Hong Kong Graduate Quant Trader (7760610, MSc gate, no years minimum, C++ accepted), the Amsterdam AI Engineer (8090609, no stated seniority floor), and — as a reach with a story to tell — the Amsterdam Junior Quantitative Researcher (6492219), whose PhD gate would have to be argued around using the first-author papers.
